name: pascal-cli
title: Pascal CLI
blurb: Free Pascal CLI on FPC and make: byte-exact counting unit, hand-written argv parser, dependency-free test suite, terminal behind a record of function pointers

verify.name: usage-error
verify.cmd:
set +e
./bin/{{ npm_name }} --bogus >/dev/null 2>&1
status=$?
echo "exit status: $status"
test "$status" -eq 2

verify.name: missing-file
verify.cmd:
set +e
./bin/{{ npm_name }} /nonexistent/file.txt >/dev/null 2>&1
status=$?
echo "exit status: $status"
test "$status" -eq 1

verify.name: stdin
verify.cmd:
test "$(printf 'alpha beta
gamma
' | ./bin/{{ npm_name }} -w)" = '3 -' && test "$(printf 'alpha beta
gamma delta
' | ./bin/{{ npm_name }})" = ' 2  4 23 -'

verify.name: parity
verify.cmd:
mkdir -p .parity
printf 'alpha beta\ngamma delta\n' > .parity/p1.txt
printf 'alpha beta\ngamma' > .parity/p2.txt
printf 'h\303\251llo w\303\266rld\n' > .parity/p3.txt
: > .parity/p4.txt
printf 'a\tb\vc\fd\n' > .parity/p5.txt
for file in .parity/p*.txt; do
  ours=$(./bin/{{ npm_name }} -l -w -c "$file" | awk '{print $1, $2, $3}')
  theirs=$(wc -l -w -c < "$file" | awk '{print $1, $2, $3}')
  echo "$file ours=[$ours] wc=[$theirs]"
  test "$ours" = "$theirs"
done
